i.n: filling ingredients - can use diced onion, garlic, chopped sausages, potato, broccoli or cauliflower, capsicum, etc.

method.s: Heat olive oil in a cast-iron pan (I use the 25cm Ironclad Pan that Amy bought me for Christmas 2020).
Soften and brown onions if using. Fry other ingredients as needed.
Separately, whisk together eggs and milk. Sift flour over top and whisk in. Add salt and pepper.
Lay out fillings in cast-iron pan. Pour egg mixture in. Shake pan gently to distribute.
